items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: Well we, Buddy PT and him, we played over there. I played with him.

ctx.x: Yeah Old man Mitchell. He was a violin player. And he was good. Well we, Buddy PT and him, we played over there. I played with him.
You never met this clarinet player, Steve Lewis, over there? Did you get to him?
